subject: Pistons palette full WCAG audit - 3 brand colors fail on dark
body:
PISTONS PALETTE WCAG AUDIT RESULTS
Date: 2026-02-22
Computed by: GD (WCAG relative luminance formula, WCAG 2.1 AA 4.5:1 normal / 3:1 large)

KEY FINDING: Pistons Red and Blue FAIL on dark backgrounds.

FULL RESULTS TABLE

#C8102E Pistons Red:
  on #FFFFFF: 5.88:1 PASS
  on #0d1117 (fd-bg): 3.22:1 LARGE-ONLY (fails for body text)
  on #141B2D (arena): 2.92:1 FAIL
  on #161b22 (fd-card): 2.94:1 FAIL

#1D42BA Pistons Blue:
  on #FFFFFF: 8.27:1 PASS
  on #0d1117: 2.29:1 FAIL
  on #141B2D: 2.07:1 FAIL
  on #161b22: 2.09:1 FAIL

#002D62 Pistons Navy:
  on #FFFFFF: 13.53:1 PASS (both bgs are light-safe)
  on all dark bgs: 1.27-1.40:1 FAIL (not usable as text on dark)

#BEC0C2 Chrome:
  on #FFFFFF: 1.82:1 FAIL (not usable as text on white)
  on all dark bgs: 9.4-10.4:1 PASS

#3FB950 Success Green:
  on #FFFFFF: 2.54:1 FAIL (not usable as text on white)
  on all dark bgs: 6.75-7.45:1 PASS

#FF3A55 Incorrect Red:
  on #FFFFFF: 3.51:1 LARGE-ONLY (fails for body text on white)
  on all dark bgs: 4.89-5.40:1 PASS

DESIGN RULES DERIVED FROM AUDIT

Rule 1: Never use #C8102E, #1D42BA, or #002D62 as TEXT color on any dark background.
  These are background colors on dark. They are accent/border colors on dark.
  Exception: large-text (18px+ or 14px+ bold) can use #C8102E on #0d1117 at 3.22:1.

Rule 2: #C8102E and #1D42BA are light-mode text colors only.
  On white: red 5.88 PASS, blue 8.27 PASS.
  MCM is currently dark-always on dashboard. Do not use brand red/blue as text on fd-card.

Rule 3: #BEC0C2 chrome is dark-mode only.
  On dark: PASS. On white: FAIL.

Rule 4: #3FB950 success green is dark-mode only.
  On dark: PASS. On white: FAIL. Never use as text color on a white bg.

Rule 5: #FF3A55 incorrect red: dark-mode OK for normal text. Light-mode: large text only.

CURRENT MCM USAGE — PASS/FAIL CHECK

index.html dark dashboard:
  Brand colors used as backgrounds/accents, not text -> NOT a text-on-dark issue for those uses.
  std-bar tier-mid: if using #1D42BA as bar fill color on dark card background -> WCAG 1.4.11 (non-text, needs 3:1) -> #1D42BA on #161b22 = 2.09:1 FAIL for non-text too.
  RECOMMENDATION: Use a lighter blue (#3479D0 or similar) for mid-tier bar fill. #3479D0 on #161b22 estimate ~4.8:1.

ACTION REQUESTED: FD decision on:
1. std-bar mid-tier color (current #1D42BA fails even as non-text on dark)
2. Any Pistons brand colors used as text on dark that GD may have missed
